about: A kind kept outside the repository, a CRM behind an API, is declared at its URL, which is taken as written; the journal the method keeps in the repository is a kind with a path. The URL is its own entrance.
yaml:
methodology: 1
canon:
  - kind: opportunity
    at: https://crm.example.org/api/opportunities
    format: json
  - kind: journal
    at: journal/
    format: markdown
